Full Access, Still in Your Hands

Connected to everything sounds like a lot — it is. That is exactly why the controls matter, and every one of them is simple, and yours.

  • You choose what it can see. Every connection is your call — and we walk through each one in plain English before anything is turned on.
  • Turn any of it off, any time. Access is a switch you own, not a door that stays open.
  • It asks before anything big. Sending, booking, buying, deleting — the important stuff waits for your OK.
  • Nothing gets paid or moved without your say-so. It can look and report freely. Your money stays put until you say go.
  • Start small if you like. Many people connect email first, and add the rest as trust grows.
  • It remembers what you teach it — and you can tell it to forget, any time.
  • The scams talk is part of Call 2. How to spot a trick, what never to share, and what Muse will never ask you for.

Full access is the point — it is how Muse does real work. The controls are how it stays yours.

Reminders are the small end of it. Muse can also take on the big jobs — the ones that usually mean hiring someone, or paying a company a lot of money.

Build a Whole Website

A real website — your services, your prices, your photos, and a book-now button. Not a placeholder. The real thing, live on the internet.

Run the Finances

Invoices sent on time and chased politely. Bills lined up so nothing is late. Every dollar in and out, kept track of.

Once a month you get a plain-words summary of how the business did — and at tax time, your records are ready to hand to your accountant.

“March, in plain words: $4,200 came in, $2,900 went out, and two invoices are still unpaid.”

Do the Research and the Math

What do your competitors charge? Which supplier is really cheaper? Is that big job priced so you actually make money on it?

How It Works

Two Calls, and Your Muse Is Set Up

All on video calls, from your own home — Call 1 sets up your Muse, Call 2 trains you on it. No jargon, ever.

Call 1 — Muse Setup

About 90 minutes · Video call

  • We set up your Muse account and get Muse working on your phone and computer.
  • Muse connected to your email and calendar — every “yes” explained in plain English before you tap it.
  • Muse taught the basics about you — your people, your routines, how you like things done.
  • You finish with three real wins done live — real jobs, finished, while you watch.
The Golden Rules You Will Learn
  1. Talk to it like a person — no special code words.
  2. Be specific — say what you want, who it is for, and by when.

Then a week to practice, with a check-in from me.

Call 2 — Muse Training

About 1 hour · A week later, video call

  • Your practice week reviewed — what worked, what confused you, all of it fixed.
  • Deeper on your track — more of the jobs that matter most to you.
  • A calm safety-and-scams talk — what is safe to share, what never to share, how to spot a trick.
  • Your “when I’m stuck” plan — what to do, in order, when something does not work.
  • Your personal cheat sheet — your top 10 asks, in your own words.

Questions

The Things People Ask First

Is It Really All Over Video Call?

Yes — every part of it. You stay home, on your own phone or computer. Nothing to travel to, nothing to install first — we do that together on Call 1.

Do I Need Any Tech Experience?

None at all. If you can hold a conversation and tap a button when we ask, you have every skill this needs. We go step by step, in plain English, at your pace. The only piece most people are missing is that nobody ever showed them.

Which Agent Will I Use?

Muse — Meta's personal AI agent. Muse does jobs, not just answers like a chatbot. Already have Muse? We set it up properly and teach you on it. Never used it? We set up your Muse together on Call 1.

Are You Selling Me the AI?

No. Muse is Meta's — it comes from Meta. Handled is the service around it: the Muse setup, the connecting, and the teaching. That is the only thing you pay us for.

Will It Be Too Complicated for Me?

No — it is taught simply. Plain everyday words, no jargon, your pace, and no silly questions. Most people are surprised how quickly it clicks.

Is It Safe? What About Scams?

You choose what Muse can see, and every choice is explained before anything is switched on. Anything can be turned off. Call 2 includes the safety-and-scams talk: what is safe to share, what never to share, and how to spot a trick.

What If I Get Stuck Afterwards?

You leave Call 2 with a “when I’m stuck” plan and your cheat sheet. Need more help after that? Book a 45-minute follow-up session for $29, whenever you need it — same for personal and business. No monthly plan.
